_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Pricing the bill on the utility's rates

description: Use this when a small business wants its electricity bill checked, a cheaper rate plan, the cost of a coming rate change, or its peak kW explained. A partial call is fine: always call scan_bill first with whatever numbers or place the user gave (e.g. bill: { total: 640 }, address: 'Phoenix, AZ' without kWh, or only kWh without an address, or a short Green Button CSV snippet, or a Texas retail bill), and the tool returns need_input with `missing` (plus `peaks` when interval rows are sent) or no_rates for Texas retail. Pass `bill` (kwh, kw, total, rate, utility, dates, charges; omit what is not stated, never guess) or `bill_text`, plus `address` (city, street, or ZIP), optional `usage_csv` and `current_rate`. Free; nothing stored.

address.description: Service address, city (such as 'Phoenix, AZ'), or ZIP code; pass whatever location the user named, even just a city

bill.description: Bill numbers already read or typed (even partial, such as only total or only kwh)

charges.description: The charge lines of this period, without payments or past balances

amount.description: Dollars on that line; a credit is negative

label.description: The line as printed, for example "Customer charge" or "Fuel charge"

kw.description: Highest or billed demand in kW, when the bill shows one

kwh.description: Total kWh used in the billing period

off_peak_kwh.description: Off-peak kWh, when the bill splits use by time of day

on_peak_kwh.description: On-peak kWh, when the bill splits use by time of day

period_end.description: Last day of the billing period, YYYY-MM-DD

period_start.description: First day of the billing period, YYYY-MM-DD

rate.description: Rate schedule or rate code as printed, for example "GSND" or "A-10"

service_address.description: Service address: street, city, state and ZIP

total.description: Current electric charges for this period, taxes included, without past balances

utility.description: Utility name as printed on the bill

bill_text.description: The text of the bill, pasted or from the PDF text layer

current_rate.description: The rate plan the business is on, when the bill does not name it

usage_csv.description: A Green Button or utility interval usage CSV (15-minute, 30-minute or hourly)

name: scan_bill

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

anyOf.description: Numbers read from one electricity bill. A partial object is fine: pass whatever fields the user gave (even just total or kwh) and leave out anything not shown; never guess.

plans.description: Other plans this business can use, cheapest first

complete.description: False when a charge could not be priced, so the cost is a lower bound

flags.description: Why to check this plan before switching

monthly_cost.description: Average cost per month on this plan for the same use, before taxes

saving_per_month.description: Current plan cost minus this plan's cost; negative means dearer; null when the current plan is unknown

billed_total.description: What the bill charged for the same parts, without taxes and fees when the lines allow

month.description: YYYY-MM the bill was priced for

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

by_peak.description: Cost at each demand band, for a rate that sets part of the bill by the peak kW

yours.description: The band this business's peak falls in

change_per_month.description: Upcoming cost minus current cost; positive means the bill goes up

peak_kw.description: The peak used to place the business in a band; null when nothing gave a kW figure

title: Check a business electricity bill
